The '''''Arbitrator''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Arbitrator'' was destroyed during an [[Assault on the Arbitrator|assault]] launched by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]], but [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] were able to save the surviving crew from being captured by Grievous with the aid of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].
